title: Eco DAO
tagline: A Decentralized Autonomous Organization that aims to support in the restoration of the environment and the world
description: A Decentralized Autonomous Organization that aims to support in the restoration of the environment and the world. The power is given to the members. They have the power to start their own campaign for the environment and for the world. As the member holds more tokens they could be able to start a campaign of their own and allows them to start some initiatives without the limitation of their location, identity etc.
how_its_made: The project is deployed on the IPFS both the front end and the backend and also the assets the project needs. The fleek is also used for more faster deployment, the Pinata is used as another pinning service. The lens protocol is also used and the Skillwallet, Superfluid, TheGraph, Covalent, Unlock is also used.
